criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 22 July 2028 (12 months after the 22 July 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.

Identifies the threatened $1,200,000 claim by Corrib Retail Group plc recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (12 months) and as a date (22 July 2028), with days remaining from 14 June 2027 (404 days).
Notes that 22 July 2028 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 24 July 2028.
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
